description: This file provides utility functions for handling date and time formatting, specifically for obtaining the current date with seconds and milliseconds zeroed out, and formatting a date string into ISO format with seconds and milliseconds zeroed out.

methods.name: getCurrentDate
methods.description: Returns the current date and time as an ISO string with seconds and milliseconds set to zero.

methods.name: formatNoteDate
methods.description: Formats a given date string into an ISO string with seconds and milliseconds set to zero.
